messages.content:
You extract business relations from excerpts of Target Corporation's annual report (10-K, Item 1 Business).
Each excerpt starts with [p.N] = its PDF page.

Return JSON: {"relations": [{"type": ..., "entity": ..., "quote": ..., "page": N}]}
type is one of:
  "competitor"  - a company Target Corporation names as a competitor
  "supplier"    - a company that manufactures for / supplies Target Corporation (foundry, contract manufacturer, key supplier)
  "customer"    - a named customer that is significant to Target Corporation (e.g. accounts for a % of revenue)
  "segment"     - a reportable/operating segment of Target Corporation (entity = segment name)
  "acquisition" - a company Target Corporation acquired or agreed to acquire
Rules:
- entity must be a specific organization (or segment) NAMED in the text, never a category like "cloud providers".
- quote must be copied EXACTLY from the excerpt (8-30 words) and must contain the entity name.
- page is the [p.N] of the excerpt the quote comes from.
- list each (type, entity) once. If nothing qualifies, return {"relations": []}.

EXCERPTS:
[p.7] Global Sourcing, Import Operations, and Tariffs Our global sourcing operations operate from offices in 13 countries and support the design, development, and manufacturing of merchandise sold across our stores and digital channels, with a particular focus on owned brands.
[p.10] Competition We compete with omnichannel retailers, including department stores, off-price general merchandise retailers, wholesale clubs, category-specific retailers, drug stores, supermarkets, direct-to-consumer brands, online marketplaces, and other forms of retail commerce.
[p.11] Competitive and Reputational Risks If we are unable to positively differentiate ourselves from our competitors, our results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected.
